title: Understanding k-Means Clustering
text: In k-Means clustering, the algorithm assigns each point to the nearest cluster center and then recalculates the cluster centers based on the mean of the points assigned to each cluster.

title: Initial Cluster Centers
text: Initially, cluster A has a center at $$(0,5)$$ and cluster B has a center at $$(6,0)$$.

title: Assigning Points to Clusters
text: Calculate the distance of each team from the initial cluster centers to determine which cluster they belong to.

title: Calculate Distances
text: Calculate the distance of Team O-Ski $$(1,1)$$ from the initial cluster centers $$(0,5)$$ and $$(6,0)$$.

title: Recalculate Cluster Centers
text: After assigning points to clusters, recalculate the center of cluster B based on the mean of the points assigned to it.
